items.title: Roland Jupiter-8
items.subtitle: 14-bit revision, serviced and calibrated on the bench
items.alt: Roland Jupiter-8 eight-voice analog polysynth, 14-bit revision, in good cosmetic condition
items.description:
A Roland Jupiter-8 in good shape — the flagship eight-voice analog polysynth Roland built between 1981 and 1984, and the machine most of the sounds you associate with that era actually came out of.
This is the 14-bit revision. Later Jupiter-8s moved from the original 12-bit DAC to a 14-bit one, which gives finer resolution on the internal control voltages — tuning and filter tracking sit more precisely across the keyboard, and the later units are the ones most players look for.
It has been through my bench rather than flipped as-found. Serious inquiries by email or phone; local pickup in Indianapolis preferred, shipping can be arranged for the right buyer.
bullets: Eight-voice analog polysynth, two VCOs per voice, Roland's classic 4-pole filter
14-bit revision — finer control-voltage resolution than the early 12-bit units
Serviced and calibrated on my own bench before listing
Local pickup in Indianapolis preferred; shipping arranged for the right buyer

items.title: Rhodes Germanium Transistor Kit
items.subtitle: Drop-in replacement pair for the Peterson Rhodes power amp
items.description:
The germanium output transistors in the Peterson Rhodes power amp are usually written off as unobtainable. They aren't. I sourced a modern germanium device with similar specs that is overrated for this application, which means it works fine here and runs cooler than the original ever did.
Each kit is a matched set, tested before it ships.
bullets: Direct drop-in for the Peterson Rhodes power amp
Modern germanium device, overrated for the application
Tested as a matched set before shipping
